stories.title: Volkswagen warns Germany's car-making industry is in jeopardy
stories.summary: The CEO of the German car-making group Volkswagen is warning that the situation at the company is "more than critical". Oliver Blume is saying that ahead of meetings with the car giant's staff. He says Volkswagen and the rest of Germany's car industry are facing "the biggest upheaval in their history" due to global headwinds and Chinese competition.

stories.title: FIDE Council bars Russian players from 2026 World Chess Olympiad
stories.summary: MOSCOW, August 24. The Council of World Chess (FIDE) has decided not to allow Russian players to participate in the 2026 World Chess Olympiad, Executive Director of the Russian Chess Federation (RCF) Alexander Tkachyov told TASS on Monday. "Our national teams will not be playing at the World Chess Olympiad. At the suggestion of FIDE Interim President [Viswanathan] Anand this decision was endorsed by the Council," Tkachyov stated. "Fortunately, there are people who put the game above political issues and worry about their own careers. But there are also people who put their personal interests above and at the moment they prevail in the Council. They won this time," he added. The 2026 World Chess Olympiad will take place on September 16-27 in Samarkand, Uzbekistan.
